description: Searches across all 49 VertoDigital case studies by keyword - client name, industry, service, or outcome. Returns matching excerpts as markdown, each with its own case-studies/<slug> URL for a full-detail fetch via vertodigital_get_page. Broad but shallow; the 4 flagship, stats-first proof points are available separately via vertodigital_why_verto with aspect: "proof_points". Read-only, no side effects, reflects the live case-studies index; matching is a case-insensitive substring match, not full-text ranking.

query.description: Filter keyword - client name, industry, service, or outcome. Examples: "cybersecurity", "LinkedIn", "SnapLogic", "pipeline", "SEO". Omit to return the full list of case studies.

name: vertodigital_search_case_studies
